text_blocks.snippet: Opsumit (macitentan) can cause common mild reactions as well as serious medical risks.
You can read more detailed prescribing and safety information directly from the Official Opsumit Site.

list.snippet: Stuffy or runny nose, sore throat
Peripheral edema (swelling of the hands, legs, or feet)
Severe birth defects: Opsumit causes harm to an unborn baby and is strictly contraindicated during pregnancy.
Liver damage: Can cause elevated liver enzymes and potential liver injury. Watch for yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, or upper right stomach pain.
Fluid retention: Swelling or rapid weight gain can occur, particularly during the first weeks of treatment.
Decreased sperm counts: May affect male fertility.

text_blocks.snippet: If you or someone you care for is taking Opsumit, let me know if you are experiencing any specific symptoms or have questions about pregnancy testing and safety protocols.
